Coram : B.N. AGRAWAL*, ALTAMAS KABIR, G.S. SINGHVI
A.P Land Encroachment Act, 1905 - s. 6 - Owner and possessor of land leasing out the land to a Company - Notice c under s. 6 by Revenue Officer to vacate land - Challenge to - Notices quashed with leave to the Government to establish its title,.,_ Writ appeal - Direction by Division Bench maintain status quo for three months - However, Authorities carrying out constructions over the said land - Contempt D petition - Upheld by Division Bench of High Court and contemnors directed to pay compensation @ of Rs. 5, 0001- per sq. yard to petitioners- Justification of- Held: Construction
Decision Date : 16-04-2008 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2200/2001 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 3 Judges
